objections.text: The deps gate finds 4 high advisories in plugins/opencode's tree (zod 4.1.8 pinned by @opencode-ai/plugin 1.19.5; toml 4.3.0 via effect ^4.1.1): no fix within the dependents' ranges

waived.reason: The author chose option 1 ('força'): accept the 4 advisories for 0.6.0. They come from @opencode-ai/plugin's own pins, nobody can fix them without a new release of that package, the plugin's inputs are local (the agent's tool arguments), the code never calls toml.parse, and the same tree shipped in 0.5.0. Re-audit when OpenCode publishes a new plugin package (docs/real-use/findings.md).
